title: Coast to Coast callers claiming time travel work at Area 51

tellings.quote: crazy whistleblowers back then it's interesting people think the whistleblower thing is a new phenomena like then people would call in and they're like we're doing time travel stuff at Area 51

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that in the 1990s people would phone in to Coast to Coast, a late-night radio talk show hosted by Art Bell, claiming to be insiders. According to Michels, some said they were doing time travel work at Area 51, a secret military base in Nevada. He tells it to show that whistleblowers coming forward about secret programs are nothing new.
